milestones.M2: Data services: Hypixel API client (async, cached, rate-limited), profile selection
milestones.M3: Dashboard, HUD widgets and economy lookups

milestones.M5: Dungeons, Kuudra, Rift, collections, shards, events
milestones.M6: Items marked for rule review (only after an explicit decision)

description.en: Read-only summary of the selected SkyBlock profile: skill average, purse, fairy souls and member list.
